title: The perpetual stew (R19.4, D127): how long a bowl lasts for the fish put in, its warmth, and eating a fish raw (R21.1)

minutes.description: Game minutes of buff each fish put in adds, by its rarity.

effects.description: What every bowl gives, whatever went in: the warmth.

flavours.description: How many fish's own stew buffs a bowl carries: the rarest kinds that went in.

cookMinutes.description: Game minutes a fish cooks in the pot before a bowl takes it (D165).

eatCasts.description: How many casts a fish eaten raw gives its stew buff for (Sushi enjoyer).

taste.description: What a fish's taste grade does (D138): the minutes it adds to a bowl, and the casts its buff lasts eaten raw, are multiplied by this.

parasites.description: The chance in a hundred that a fish eaten raw leaves the player with the debuff, by the fish's risk (D138).

aquarium.description: How many fish the room's aquarium holds.
